_about: Maps software names (lowercase) to NVD product IDs (part:vendor:product) for the live NVD lookup. Each product ID was confirmed to exist in the NVD CPE dictionary on 2026-11-05. 'unsupported' lists software NVD can't check reliably by version, with the reason shown in import results. Unlisted names fall back to an NVD product search; add a 'cpe' field to an item to override.
